data.name: Faariza
data.gender_notes: Faariza is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root fa-ra-za, meaning to cover or veil. In Islamic context, Faariza refers to one who is refined and pure in character and actions, often symbolizing the veiling of one's soul for the sake of God. The name Faariza carries the meaning “Refined, Pure” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Faariza usually hope their child will grow to embody refined, pure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of inner purity and dedication to God.
data.etymology: Faariza belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Refined, Pure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faariza total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: فارزة
in_arabic.meaning: فارزة تعني الشخصية التي تفرق أو تميز بين الأشياء
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فارزة مشتق من الفعل فارز والذي يعني التمييز أو التفريق. في اللغة العربية، يُستخدم هذا الاسم لوصف الشخص الذي يمتلك القدرة على التمييز بين الأشياء أو الأفكار المختلفة. كما يمكن أن يشير إلى الشخص الذي يلعب دورًا حاسمًا في فصل أو تمييز الحق عن الباطل.

in_urdu.name: فارزہ
in_urdu.meaning: فارزہ کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو چیزیں الگ کرتا ہے یا مختلف پہچانتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: فارزہ نام عربی زبان کے الفعل 'فارز' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے 'الگ کرنا' یا 'تمیز کرنا'۔ اردو میں، یہ نام اس شخص کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو مختلف چیزوں کے درمیان فرق کر سکتا ہے یا صحیح کو غلط سے الگ کر سکتا ہے۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے کیونکہ یہ معاشرے میں سچ اور جھوٹ کے درمیان تمیز کرنے کی صلاحیت کی نمائندگی کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फारज़ा
in_hindi.meaning: फारज़ा का अर्थ है जो व्यक्ति वस्तुओं को अलग करता है या भिन्न पहचानता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: फारज़ा नाम अरबी भाषा के क्रिया 'फारज़' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है 'अलग करना' या 'विभेद करना'। हिंदी में, यह नाम उस व्यक्ति के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो विभिन्न वस्तुओं के बीच अंतर कर सकता है या सही को गलत से अलग कर सकता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम सच्चाई और झूठ के बीच भेद करने की क्षमता का प्रतीक माना जाता है।

in_english.name: Faariza
in_english.meaning: Faariza means one who differentiates or distinguishes between things
in_english.long_meaning: The name Faariza is derived from the Arabic root 'F-R-Z', which means 'to differentiate' or 'to distinguish'. This name holds a significant meaning in Islamic tradition, as it refers to an individual who possesses the ability to discern and distinguish between right and wrong, truth and falsehood. Faariza is a name that symbolizes wisdom, clarity, and the ability to make sound judgments. In Muslim cultures, this name is often chosen for its positive connotations and spiritual significance.

Faariza serves as a reminder of the importance of maintaining one's privacy and dignity in public, which is a deeply ingrained aspect of Islamic culture.
data.spiritual_significance: On a deeper spiritual level, the name Faariza conveys the idea of striving for inner purity and refinement, going beyond mere physical appearances. It is a call to cultivate the soul through continued spiritual practice, self-reflection, and obedience to God's commandments. By veiling or hiding one's worldly desires and egoistic tendencies, the individual can seek meaning and purpose in their relationship with the Divine. As such, Faariza serves as a source of inspiration for those on the path of spiritual growth, encouraging them to continually refine their character and actions in the pursuit of closeness to God.
